gold_assessment.reasoning: Gold: abdominal pain only. Generated cc-001 adds light vaginal bleeding to chief complaint. Abdominal pain component is covered, but the bleeding is an added element.

Gold: constant periumbilical pain that is worsening. Generated hpi-001 covers worsening over several days; hpi-003 covers constant nature; hpi-002 describes mid‑lower abdomen primarily below umbilicus (slightly different location). Overall character (constant, worsening) is covered, but exact periumbilical location is altered.
Gold: severity 8/10. Generated hpi-004: pain severity rated 8/10. Direct match.
Gold: light per vaginal bleeding (PV bleeding). Generated hpi-008: light pink vaginal bleeding/discharge. Bleeding is covered but color and addition of ‘discharge’ are extra.

Gold: some difficulty passing urine, despite no dysuria/frequency. Generated ros-007: denies urinary symptoms. This contradicts difficulty passing urine. No generated HPI fact captures difficulty passing urine; thus the gold fact is omitted and functionally contradicted in ROS.
Gold: daily bowel movements, normal stool. No generated fact mentions bowel frequency or stool consistency.
Gold: constipation for a week last week. Generated hpi-007: constipation occurred last week and has now improved. This matches timing and duration with minor added status (now improved).
Gold: LMP 2 weeks ago. Generated hpi-009: last menstrual period ~2–3 weeks ago. This approximates the same timing; mild imprecision but essentially covered.
Gold: last foreign travel 1 year ago. Generated sh-004: traveled abroad within the past year. Consistent and covers the fact.

Gold: denies dysuria or urinary frequency. Generated ros-007: denies urinary symptoms (supports denial of dysuria/frequency) but this conflicts with HPI difficulty passing urine. As ROS alone, the denial is covered; overall chart is internally inconsistent in the generated set.

Gold: denies any additional PV discharge. Generated ros-002: ROS positive for vaginal bleeding/discharge. This captures presence of bleeding but not the specific denial of additional discharge; in fact it implies discharge is present. Denial of discharge is not represented and is effectively contradicted.
Gold: eating and drinking ok. No generated ROS fact addresses appetite or oral intake adequacy; only plan-003 addresses ability to tolerate fluids as a warning sign, not current status.
Gold: has not checked temp and does not feel feverish. Generated ros-005: denies fever. Feeling afebrile is covered; lack of temperature measurement is omitted.

Gold: not feeling faint. No generated fact explicitly mentions faintness, but that absence is neutral; there is no conflicting statement. Since the generated ROS does not state anything about faintness, this specific gold fact is effectively omitted, not contradicted. Status: OMITTED.
Gold: denies shortness of breath or shoulder tip pain. Generated ros-006: denies shortness of breath (covered). No mention of shoulder tip pain, so that part is omitted.
Gold: nausea. Generated ros-003: ROS positive for nausea; hpi-006 also reports nausea. Fully covered.
Gold: denies vomiting or diarrhoea. Generated ros-008: denies vomiting. No mention of diarrhoea, so diarrhoea denial is omitted. Overall: PARTIALLY_COVERED.
Gold: nil significant past medical history. No generated fact describes past medical history at all.
Gold: no regular medications. Generated med-001 only notes Implanon; does not explicitly state no other/regular meds.
Gold: Implanon contraceptive implant inserted 1 year ago. Generated med-001: uses etonogestrel implant (Implanon) for contraception; asm-004: implant in place for ~1 year. Fully covered.
Gold: allergic to amoxicillin. Generated allergy-001 and asm-003 both document amoxicillin allergy.
Gold: works as a teacher. Generated sh-001: school teacher. Covered.
Gold: has been able to work as usual. Generated facts note occupation but do not state functional ability to work as usual.
Gold: lives with husband and his family. Generated sh-002: lives with husband and husband’s family. Directly covered.
Gold: does not smoke, drink alcohol, or use recreational drugs. No generated fact addresses this; therefore this gold fact is OMITTED, not covered.

Gold: abdominal pain ? cause (unclear cause). Generated asm-001: acute lower abdominal pain, constant and worsening, but no explicit uncertainty re cause. Pain is covered; ‘of unclear cause’ is omitted.
Gold: needs to check pregnancy test today. Generated plan-002: perform a pregnancy test today; hpi-012 also notes pregnancy test recommended today. Covered.

Gold: contact clinic immediately if test is positive. Generated fu-002 and fu-003: if test positive, patient should be seen promptly/sooner. Clinical intent covered, timing (‘immediately’) approximated by ‘promptly’.

Gold: urgent examination with doctor booked. Generated plan-001: arrange in‑person abdominal examination; fu-001/fu-003: call support line to arrange appointment, follow-up after examination. This shifts from ‘already booked’ to ‘to be arranged’, so exact status differs. Thus, partially covered with discrepancy in whether it is already booked vs to be arranged.

Gold: get in touch earlier if pain worse/new symptoms develop. Generated plan-003/fu-003: seek urgent evaluation if pain worsens or symptoms worsen/if test positive. Worsening pain is covered; ‘new symptoms’ are partially represented as ‘symptoms worsen’, but not explicitly new symptoms.

gen_assessment.reasoning: Abdominal pain is supported by gold cc-001. Light vaginal bleeding as part of the chief complaint is an addition; gold lists PV bleeding in HPI, not as the chief complaint.
Gold HPI does not specify onset (‘a few days ago’). Worsening is supported (hpi-001), but the ‘few days’ detail is added.
Gold specifies periumbilical pain; generated specifies mid-lower abdomen primarily below umbilicus. This is a modified/anatomically different location, not directly in the gold facts.
Gold: pain constant and getting worse. Generated hpi-003: pain described as constant. Supported for character.
Gold: severity 8/10. Generated: rated 8/10. Directly supported.
Gold does not describe radiation of pain. ‘Pain does not radiate’ is new information.

Gold: nausea present (ros-007) and denies vomiting (ros-008). Generated: nausea without vomiting—supported. Any mention of ‘no fever’ in this HPI cluster is not in gold HPI; fever status is in ROS as ‘does not feel feverish’ (ros-004), so that piece is only loosely aligned.
Gold: constipation for a week last week. Generated: constipation occurred last week and has now improved. Timing matches; ‘now improved’ is additional but consistent.

Gold: light PV bleeding; denies other PV discharge. Generated: light pink vaginal bleeding/discharge. Bleeding is supported; ‘discharge’ and pink color are additions and the presence of discharge conflicts with the gold denial of other discharge.
Gold: LMP 2 weeks ago. Generated: LMP about 2–3 weeks ago. Approximate but consistent.
Gold provides no information on menstrual regularity. Irregular periods since implant are new.
Gold only notes need for pregnancy test today; no history of a test one month ago.
Gold plan: needs to check pregnancy test today. Generated: pregnancy test recommended today. Supported.
Gold contains no obstetric history. ‘No history of pregnancy’ is new.

Gold: Implanon contraceptive implant 1 year ago. Generated: implant for contraception, dose/route/frequency not documented. The presence of implant is supported; statement about missing dose/route/frequency is an added documentation detail.
Gold: allergic to amoxicillin. Fully supported.
Gold: teacher. Generated: school teacher. Directly supported.
Gold: lives with husband and his family. Generated: lives with husband and husband’s family. Supported.
Gold does not mention sexual activity. Regular sexual activity is new information.
Gold: last foreign travel 1 year ago. Generated: traveled abroad within the past year. Consistent with gold timing, though phrased more vaguely.
Gold chief complaint/HPI: abdominal pain. Generated ROS positive for abdominal pain aligns with those sections.

Gold: PV bleeding present; denies any additional PV discharge. Generated: ROS positive for vaginal bleeding/discharge. Bleeding is supported; presence of discharge conflicts with the gold’s denial of additional discharge.
Gold: nausea. Generated: ROS positive for nausea. Supported.
Gold: constipation for a week last week. Generated: ROS positive for constipation in the past week. Supported.
Gold: has not checked temp and does not feel feverish. Generated: denies fever. The absence of fever is supported, but there is no mention of not checking temperature.
Gold: denies shortness of breath. Generated: denies shortness of breath. Supported. (Shoulder tip pain component is simply not mentioned in this gen fact.)
Generated: denies urinary symptoms. Gold: no dysuria/frequency but does report some difficulty passing urine (hpi-004). Denial of all urinary symptoms contradicts the gold HPI.
Gold: denies vomiting/diarrhoea. Generated: denies vomiting. Supported for vomiting; diarrhoea denial is omitted but not contradicted.
Gold does not mention weight loss. Denial of weight loss is new.

Gold assessment: abdominal pain ? cause; HPI: constant, getting worse. Generated: acute lower abdominal pain, constant and worsening over several days. Character and worsening supported; ‘acute’, ‘lower’ location, and duration ‘several days’ are additions; unclear cause is omitted.

Gold: light PV bleeding; Implanon 1 year ago. Generated: intermittent vaginal bleeding with light pink discharge in setting of implant contraception. Bleeding and implant context are supported; ‘intermittent’, ‘light pink’, and presence of discharge conflict with the gold’s denial of other discharge.
Gold: amoxicillin allergy. Supported.
Gold: Implanon 1 year ago. Generated: implant in place for ~1 year. Supported.
Gold plan: needs pregnancy test today. Generated asm-005: assessment addresses pregnancy testing status. Partially supported in intent; ‘status’ as an assessment item is an added framing.
Gold: urgent examination with doctor has been booked. Generated: arrange in-person abdominal examination in clinic. The need for exam is supported; status ‘booked’ vs ‘to be arranged’ conflicts.
Gold: needs to check pregnancy test today. Generated: perform a pregnancy test today. Supported.

Gold follow-up: get in touch earlier if pain worse/new symptoms. Generated: seek urgent evaluation if pain worsens or unable to tolerate fluids. Worsening pain supported; ‘unable to tolerate fluids’ is new; ‘new symptoms’ component not explicitly mentioned.
Gold note does not explicitly describe patient education on need for exam or warning signs; this is added explanatory detail.
Gold does not state whether any meds were or were not given for abdominal pain. ‘No medications documented at this time’ is new documentation commentary.

Gold: plan to test for pregnancy and contact clinic if positive; no explicit treatment for bleeding mentioned. Generated: no specific treatment for vaginal bleeding; follow pregnancy test results. The absence of specific treatment is implied but not stated in gold; following test results is consistent with gold plan.
Gold: urgent examination already booked. Generated: call support line to arrange clinic appointment. Need for exam supported; booking-status differs (booked vs to be scheduled).
Gold: contact clinic immediately if pregnancy test positive. Generated: if test positive, patient should be seen promptly. Supported in intent and timing.

Gold: get in touch earlier if pain worse/new symptoms; contact clinic immediately if positive test; urgent exam booked. Generated: follow up after exam or sooner if symptoms worsen or test positive. Worsening symptoms and positive test criteria are consistent; link to ‘after examination’ and omission of ‘new symptoms’ and ‘already booked’ exam are differences.
